title: An InSAR Phase Unwrapping Framework for Large-scale and Complex Events
abstract: arXiv:2603.21378v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Phase unwrapping remains a critical and challenging problem in InSAR processing, particularly in scenarios involving complex deformation patterns. In earthquake-related deformation, shallow sources can generate surface-breaking faults and abrupt displacement discontinuities, which severely disrupt phase continuity and often cause conventional unwrapping algorithms to fail. Another limitation of existing learning-based unwrapping methods is their reliance on fixed and relatively small input sizes, while real InSAR interferograms are typically large-scale and spatially heterogeneous. This mismatch restricts the applicability of many neural network approaches to real-world data. In this work, we present a phase unwrapping framework based on a diffusion model, developed to process large-scale interferograms and to address phase discontinuities caused by deformation. translated_title: 一种面向大规模复杂事件的高分辨率InSAR相位解缠框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：相位解缠在InSAR处理中仍然是一个关键且具有挑战性的问题，尤其是在涉及复杂形变模式的场景中。在地震相关形变中，浅层震源可能产生地表破裂和突然的位移不连续性，这会严重破坏相位连续性，常常导致传统解缠算法失败。现有基于学习的解缠方法的另一个局限性是它们依赖固定且相对较小的输入尺寸，而真实InSAR干涉图通常是大规模且空间异质性的。这种不匹配限制了众多神经网络方法在实际数据中的应用。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于扩散模型的相位解缠框架，旨在处理大规模干涉图并解决由形变引起的相位不连续性。通过利用扩散模型架构，所提出的方法...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的InSAR相位解缠框架，能处理大规模干涉图并有效应对地震等复杂事件引起的相位不连续问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a diffusion model-based InSAR phase unwrapping framework that can handle large-scale interferograms and effectively address phase discontinuities caused by complex events such as earthquakes.
